note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative. The two desks are identical except the route of the proposal card (procedure: through the supplied steps, then clipped to the contract; beside: set down beside the contract, off the track). The captions are neutral, supplied comparison labels: 'informal' carries no judgement; nothing is said about whether either change is valid or effective, and no outcome or preference is shown (same size, stroke and timing in both desks). Brief customizable fields not exposed (coordinator decision BRIEF CUSTOMIZABLE FIELDS, SESSION_HANDOFF 2026-10-05): clauses as a list (the one change clause is clause), schedules, definitions, priorities, actorLabels (no actors), actionProgress and finalState (each route always completes). objectLabels = proposal (the card label). Coordinator decision (standing rule 2026-09-26, docs/AUTHORING.md item 20, from LAW-0687/0689–0692): after trying the fallback layouts (side-by-side boards, a stacked contract on narrow boards, a shared step legend drawn once, decoupled small stations), the 1:1 frame cannot hold the near-maximum contract title (62 characters) and card label (47) at ≥ 16 px next to four steps; the stress contract title is capped at 50 characters and the card label at 37 (both still longer than the baseline: 27 and 23), measured with the module's own layout in every ratio.
